issuer: the Department of Motor Vehicles (the Director of Road Safety and Transportation)

licence.name: driving licence, class E (private cars and jeeps)

note: Read 2026-11-03 under gov.tc/dmv. The Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Ordinance (Cap. 13.02, revised as at 31 March 2021): no driving licence or learner's permit to anyone under seventeen (s. 8); a first licence expires on the holder's birthday after the fourth anniversary of its issue (s. 4(4)(a)), so it runs four years and up to one more: four, the whole years, is held. Its Regulations' Schedule 3: issuing or renewing a licence for classes C, D, E or F, $150. The Department's fee page gives class E $150 new or renewed too (it puts G with C, D and E where the Schedule puts G at the higher fee; class E is the same in both). The learner's permit ($30) and the tests ($20, $20, $30) aren't held, nor the shorter licence of someone on a work permit (s. 4(4)(c)). No identity card and no exchange list were read.

sources.title: Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Ordinance, Cap. 13.02, revised as at 31 March 2021, Department of Motor Vehicles, Turks and Caicos Islands
sources.said: 8. A driving licence, learner’s permit or visitor’s driving permit shall not be issued to any person who is under the age of seventeen years. ... (4) A driving licence shall— (a) if issued to a person for the first time under this section, expire on the birthday of the person occurring next after the fourth anniversary of the date of issue ... 2. Issue or renewal of driving licence— (a) for one or more of the following classes of motor vehicles— C. Trucks under 2 tons D. Vehicles designed to carry more than 7 passengers E. Private cars and jeeps F. Public service vehicles ... $150
